# NBA Finals Paper-Trading Dataset — Canonical Historical Record (NBA T1 Era)

**Frozen:** 2026-06-14 (SESSION 63, T-174 WS3) — **RE-FROZEN 2026-06-16 (SESSION 64, GG-036 G5 resolution)**
**Generated by:** `scripts/build_clean_dataset.py` → `src/prediction_market_bot/analytics/clean_dataset.py`
**Source ledger:** `logs/.vps_portfolio_cache.json` (pulled-down live VPS book, 2026-06-16, post-G5-resolve)

This is the authoritative, immutable record of every paper bet placed during the
NBA Finals — the close-out artifact of the NBA T1 paper-trading era. The 41 G5
positions (game_date 2026-06-13) are now **resolved** from real `nba_api` box
scores (GG-036); the book contains **158 closed bets, zero open**.

## Files

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `nba_finals_clean_dataset.csv` | 158 bets (all closed), one row each, contamination LABELED |
| `nba_finals_clean_dataset_summary.json` | Aggregates: clean/contaminated split, per-Finals-game breakdown |

## Ground truth (GG-034)

Realized P&L is derived from the position ledger (`Σ pnl + exit_pnl` over
`closed_positions`), **not** the stored `total_realized_pnl` scalar — which was
desynced by cross-process clobbering (GG-034, resolved S63). The ledger value is
corroborated to the cent by the append-only C6 audit log, and the live book's
stored scalar now reconciles to the ledger (−$248.90 == −$248.90).

**Authoritative realized P&L = −$248.90** (24.9% drawdown on $1000).

## G5 resolution (GG-036)

The 41 G5 bets were unresolvable at S63 because `nba_api` had no 2026-06-13 box
scores. Three days later the data backfilled; the bets were settled from real box
scores via `run_resolve_local.py` (no fabrication). **G5 net realized = +$2.31**
(22 W / 19 L) — the largest single exposure in the book's history (~$1,003
deployed) settled essentially break-even.

## Contamination is labeled, not dropped (operator directive)

Every bet carries `is_clean` (bool) and `contamination` (pipe-joined reasons).
No row is filtered. Three contamination sources:

| Flag | Meaning | Governance |
|------|---------|------------|
| `duplicate_twin` | `duplicate_of` set — a late-cron duplicate bet (double exposure) | T-169 / GG-031 |
| `fee_contaminated` | Directional net-of-fee edge was negative | ADR-0016 |
| `kalshi_order_failed` | Kalshi demo order never placed; paper fill not market-validated | GG-014 |
| `order_local_only` | No order ever submitted to a venue | (none in this book) |

> record is **−$212.25 / −21.2%** — better than the headline but still past the

## Regenerate

```bash
.venv311/bin/python scripts/build_clean_dataset.py \
  --portfolio logs/.vps_portfolio_cache.json \
  --out data/nba_finals_clean_dataset.csv \
  --summary-json data/nba_finals_clean_dataset_summary.json
```

The column order (`clean_dataset.COLUMNS`) is the stable bet-record contract that
the MLB build (WS4) inherits — see `bet_record_contract.py`.
